meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 导入已有小说并整理成便于继续创作的格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有半成品小说想转入写作工具继续创作
copy.tagline_en: Import existing novels and reorganize them for continued writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an unfinished novel you'd like to keep writing with a structured workflow.

howto.what: 把已写好的小说(半成品或完本)反向解析成标准项目目录结构,自动按篇幅拆解全书,产出拆文库和可续写的写作工程(设定、大纲、正文、追踪等)。
howto.when: 当用户发出「/story-import」「导入小说」「反向解析」等指令时触发。

howto.what_en: Parses an existing novel (draft or finished) into a standard project structure, auto-routing by length to long/short analysis pipelines, and outputs a breakdown library plus a writable project (settings, outline, text, tracking).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says commands like `/story-import`, '导入小说' (import novel), or '反向解析' (reverse-parse).
